verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents a built-in analytics capability that tracks search queries, click events and conversions to measure search quality and find improvement opportunities. That covers the core of seeing what users search for and click. However, the evidence never explicitly names a top-queries report or a no-result-queries view. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of top-queries and no-result-queries reports, a click-through-rate metric or dashboard, and independent hands-on corroboration of the analytics feature.
